buyer_added_terms.text: Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Nagar Panchayat Rupauli, District Purnia, Bihar Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 30 m High Mast National Flag Pole 1. EXPERIENCE: The Bidder or the OEM of the offered product shall have the experience and past perform ance selected in the bid, in supply of same or similar products (high mast or tapered steel poles of 30 m h eight or more, including installation). Copies of work orders or contracts with invoices or completion certifi cates shall be submitted as proof. 2. NON-BLACKLISTING AFFIDAVIT: The Bidder shall submit a notarised affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of Rs. 1,000 declaring that the Bidder has not been blacklisted, debarred or banned by any Central o r State Government Department, PSU, Urban Local Body or GeM. The affidavit shall be executed on or afte r the Bid Published Date and before the Bid End Date, and shall mention the Bid Number. 3. SERVICE SUPPORT IN BIHAR: The successful Bidder shall establish or nominate a service office in Bi har within 30 days of award and maintain it throughout the warranty period. Preference to eligible bidders of Bihar shall be as per the Bihar Purchase Preference Policy, 2024. 4. AVERAGE ANNUAL TURNOVER: The Bidder shall have the minimum average annual turnover specifie d in the bid (50 percent of the estimated bid value) for the last three financial years. It shall be supported b y audited balance sheets or a Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant certificate on letterhead with a vali d UDIN, generated on or before the Bid Published Date. The Buyer may verify the UDIN. 5. OEM AUTHORISATION: Where the Bidder is not the OEM, a valid OEM Authorisation Certificate specific to this bid shall be submitted. 6. REPLACEMENT OF DAMAGED MATERIAL: Any supplied item found damaged, defective or not confor ming to the approved specification at delivery or installation shall be replaced within 7 days of intimation, at no additional cost to the Department. 7. EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (EMD): EMD is a mandatory criterion of this bid. All other matters relatin g to EMD shall be dealt with in accordance with the GFR. 8. PERFORMANCE SECURITY: The successful Bidder shall furnish ePBG as specified in the bid, valid for 2 months beyond the warranty period. 9. SHORTFALL DOCUMENTS: Shortfall documents may be sought only for historical documents which e xisted on the Bid Opening Date, have not changed thereafter, and give no undue advantage to any bidder, through the GeM portal. 10. GST REGISTRATION AND PAN: The Bidder shall submit self-attested copies of the valid GST Registration Certificate, the GST return of the last quarter or last month (whichever is latest), and PAN.

11. QUALITY CERTIFICATION: The Bidder or the OEM of the offered product shall possess the following v alid certificates, issued on or before the Bid Published Date and valid on the date of bid submission: (a) ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System; (b) ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management System; (c) ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health and Safety Management System. These certificates shall be issued by a Certification Body accredited by a National Accreditation Body that is a signatory to the IAF (International A ccreditation Forum) MLA, and shall be verifiable on the IAF CertSearch or accreditation body portal. 12. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS: All documents, certificates, affidavits and undertakings sought in the bi d, this ATC and corrigenda, if any, shall be uploaded. Failure to submit any of them may lead to rejection o f the bid, subject to GeM provisions on shortfall documents. 13. SERVICE SUPPORT: The Bidder or OEM shall provide a dedicated toll-free or mobile number, email ID and service contact person for complaints during the warranty period. 14. COMPLIANCE WITH TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION: All goods and works shall strictly comply with the uploaded Technical Specification (Ref. No. 1005 dated 31.10.2026), the Annexure A drawing and applicabl e standards. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
